# Serenity Skill

⚠️ **Trading warning / Avertissement trading** : informational only, not investment advice. This is a research support skill: it ranks research priorities, executes no trade and issues no buy or sell command, and the trading decision stays with you. A third-party community build, hosted in the clawock repository but not written by its author: an independent, methodology-only project (a muxu-compatible community build) inspired by the public Serenity method associated with @aleabitoreddit. It turns an investment agent into a supply-chain bottleneck hunter with a fixed reasoning chain: start from the market story, name the system change driving demand, map the value chain layer by layer (demand, integrators, modules, chips, process and packaging, equipment, materials, infrastructure), find the scarce layer where suppliers are few, qualification is long or expansion is hard, and only then name public companies, with evidence and an explicit statement of what could prove the idea wrong. It routes requests into theme scans across US, Hong Kong, A-share, Taiwan, Japan, Korea and Europe markets, single-company challenges, candidate comparisons, research conversations and a learning mode that teaches the method one question at a time. Its evidence standards are written down: primary sources first (filings, exchange documents, transcripts, official orders), social posts treated as lead generation rather than proof, deep scans aiming at a universe of at least 20 companies and at least...
